board.notePlaceholder: A decision, a convention, a warning…

map.hint: Click a desk to open its terminal, anywhere else to go there.

timeline.title: Activity

timeline.empty: No desk activity in this period.

integration.title: Integrate {{desk}}'s work
integration.nothingToMerge: Nothing to integrate: {{target}} already has all the desk's committed work.
integration.behind_one: {{target}} has {{count}} commit the desk does not have
integration.behind_other: {{target}} has {{count}} commits the desk does not have

uncommitted.hint: Only committed work is integrated. Commit these changes here, or ask the desk to do it.

integration.busy: The desk is working: wait until it is done.
integration.notIdle: Available when the desk is waiting for instructions.

conflicts.title: Conflicts expected with {{target}}
conflicts.hint: {{desk}} can merge the target into its branch and resolve the conflicts itself.
conflicts.prompt: Merge the branch `{{target}}` into your branch `{{branch}}`, resolve the conflicts, check that everything works (run the tests if there are any) and commit the result.

integration.untracked: New file, not tracked by git yet.
integration.truncated: The diff is too long: it was truncated.
integration.targetDirty: {{path}}, where {{target}} is checked out, has uncommitted changes: commit or stash them before merging.
integration.mergeInCheckout: The merge will happen in {{path}}, where {{target}} is checked out.
integration.mergeWithoutCheckout: {{target}} is not checked out anywhere: the branch will be updated directly, without touching any file.
integration.updateHint: Merges the new commits of {{target}} into the desk's branch.

errors.desk_dirty: The desk has uncommitted changes: commit them first.

alert.title: Claude subscription at {{percent}}%
alert.body: The {{window}} resets at {{reset}}. Past the limit, desks stop until then.

lead.label: Team lead
lead.description: takes the requests, splits them into clear tasks, hands them to colleagues with the delegate tool, follows progress and checks the integration. Codes little itself.

developer.label: Development
developer.description: implements the requested features, with tests, and commits as it goes.

frontend.label: Front end
frontend.description: user interface: components, styles, accessibility and API integration.

backend.label: Back end
backend.description: API, data, server logic and performance.

tests.label: Tests and quality
tests.description: writes and runs the tests, reviews colleagues' work and reports regressions.

reviewer.label: Review
reviewer.description: reviews colleagues' changes, suggests fixes and checks that the tests pass.

docs.label: Documentation
docs.description: README, guides and useful comments, kept up to date with the code.

phoneNotifications.title: Phone notifications
phoneNotifications.intro: Workspace posts notifications to a Discord channel: turn on the notifications of that channel in the Discord app on your phone.

steps.channel: In Discord, create a private channel (on your own server, for instance).
steps.webhook: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New webhook → Copy webhook URL.
steps.paste: Paste the URL below, save, then send a test.

phoneNotifications.webhookSet: Webhook saved ({{hint}}) — paste a new URL to replace it

eventLabels.attention: a desk needs me (question, permission, error, limit)
eventLabels.finished: a desk finishes a task longer than 5 minutes

phoneNotifications.whenAway: Nothing is sent while a Workspace tab is open and visible; notifications go out 30 seconds after you leave.
phoneNotifications.publicUrlHint: So that the notification opens the desk's terminal directly (e.g. a Tailscale address). Leave empty for no link.
phoneNotifications.testSent: Test sent: check your Discord channel.

errors.invalid_input: Invalid URL: a Discord webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…) and an http(s) address are needed.

search.title: Search the conversations
search.placeholder: A word, an error, a file name…
search.hint: Searches every desk's prompts and answers (ignoring case and accents).
search.countTruncated_one: The {{count}} most recent results: refine the search to see the others.
search.countTruncated_other: The {{count}} most recent results: refine the search to see the others.

stats.teamworkHint: Automatic wake-ups on messages · tasks handed over by a colleague
